title: SharedCard
description: What leaves the device when a card is shared with other people (target share, ADR-0036, ADR-0048). Whether a field may be shared depends on whether it is public information one can point to, not on the kind of field. The projection holds content and provenance, plus language, the validity period and aliases. A source, a player entry and a refs entry are kept only with a public http or https address (the same rule, isPublicSourceUri). A refs entry keeps system, id and url; if none remain, refs is absent. No store identity (uri, externalId), no origin system, no worlds, tags, class, visibility, release, training, status, rating, edges, structured state or private player field (personalityType). contentHash is the hash of the hashed card content of this projection (ADR-0034) and does not cover the descriptive fields. Built by shareProjection in packages/core after the gate allowed the card for share.

language.description: BCP 47 language of the title and body. Travels with a shared card (ADR-0048). Not part of the content hash.

aliases.description: Other names for the subject. Travels with a shared card (ADR-0048). Not part of the content hash.

validFrom.description: First day the statement applies, inclusive. Travels with a shared card (ADR-0048). Not part of the content hash.

validUntil.description: Last day the statement applies, inclusive. Travels with a shared card (ADR-0048). Not part of the content hash.

source.description: Kept only as a public http or https address; any other source is dropped (ADR-0036).

refs.description: External refs kept only when url is a public address under the same rule as source (ADR-0048). An entry keeps system, id and url. Absent when none remain.

allOf.description: A shared evidenced or said card names its public external source (ADR-0036).

playerField.title: SharedPlayerField
playerField.description: Player-field entries that cite a public source only.

publicSourceRef.title: PublicSourceRef
publicSourceRef.description: An absolute http or https address without user information: a public external source (ADR-0036). The schema checks the form; isPublicSourceUri in packages/core also rejects IP literals, private and special-use host names.

sharedRef.title: SharedExternalRef
sharedRef.description: An external ref that has a public url. system and url are kept; id is kept when the card had one. url uses the same public-address form as source (ADR-0036, ADR-0048). The schema checks the form; isPublicSourceUri also rejects IP literals and private host names.

system.description: Lower-case slug of the other system.

id.description: The thing's identifier in that system.

url.description: A public http or https address, the same form as source.
